issues.description: Gemma 2 distillation topology contradiction. Line 792 describes it as '27B→9B→2B model cascade' (sequential). Line 1105 explicitly says 'parallel distillation instead of cascading' and explains the architectural insight that parallel pairs avoid compounding approximation errors. These directly contradict each other within the same paper. The Gemma 2 paper describes parallel distillation (both 9B and 2B distilled independently from 27B), so line 1105 is correct.
issues.current_text_line_792: Gemma~2~\citep{2408.00118} validates this approach at industrial scale, embedding KD directly into the pre-training loop for its 27B$\to$9B$\to$2B model cascade.
issues.current_text_line_1105: distilling the 27B teacher into both the 9B and 2B students independently (parallel distillation instead of cascading)
issues.suggested_fix: Change line 792 from '27B→9B→2B model cascade' to '27B→9B and 27B→2B parallel distillation' or '27B model family (9B, 2B)'. Remove the word 'cascade' and the sequential arrow notation.

issues.description: PACED is grouped under 'Dynamics (Weight)' in Table 1 via \multirow with TIP. But PACED's core contribution is curriculum/difficulty-based prompt sampling (§6.2 Curriculum), not token/sample weighting (§6.1). Figure 1 places PACED under §6.2 Curriculum. Table 1's category misleadingly groups a curriculum method with a weighting method.
issues.suggested_fix: Either: (a) Change the \multirow category to 'Dynamics' without the '(Weight)' qualifier and show both TIP and PACED under it, or (b) Split into two rows: TIP under 'Dynamics (Weight)' and PACED under 'Dynamics (Curriculum)'.

issues.description: f-divergence notation inconsistency. The notation block (line 120) declares '$D_f$' for general f-divergence. The formal definition (line 175) and inline use (line 186) also use '$D_f$'. But the main OPD loss equation (line 171) and the GKD/MiniLLM applied descriptions (lines 190, 194) use '$\mathcal{D}_f$' (calligraphic D). The paper alternates between D_f and \mathcal{D}_f for the same concept.
issues.suggested_fix: Pick one notation and use it throughout. Since the notation block declares $D_f$, change lines 171, 173, 190, 194 from $\mathcal{D}_f$ to $D_f$. Alternatively, update the notation block to declare $\mathcal{D}_f$.

inconsistencies.description: KETCHUP year mismatch. Table 2 lists KETCHUP as '2025' but references.bib says year=2026 (EACL). The arXiv preprint date is April 2025 (2504.19024), but the publication venue is EACL 2026. Other entries in the same table use publication year (GKD=2024 for ICLR 2024, though arXiv was 2023; MiniLLM=2024 for ICLR 2024, though arXiv was 2023). To be consistent with the GKD/MiniLLM convention, KETCHUP should be 2026.
inconsistencies.suggested_fix: Change KETCHUP's year from '2025' to '2026' in Table 2 (line 399) to match the publication year convention used by other entries.

issues.description: Constrained (\citep{2509.22921}) taxonomy mismatch. Figure 1 places it under §4.3 RL-Augmented Objectives (with G-OPD, RLKD, REOPOLD etc.). Table 2 places it under 'Objective: Fixed Divergences' (before the Adaptive Divergences midrule). The body text discusses it in §4.1 Fixed Divergences (line 712, alongside KETCHUP/MiniLLM). The CMDP formulation has RL connections, but the body text treatment aligns with Table 2's Fixed placement. Figure 1's RL-Augmented placement is the outlier.
issues.suggested_fix: Move Constrained from §4.3 RL-Augmented to §4.1 Fixed Divergences in Figure 1 to match Table 2 and body text. Alternatively, if the CMDP formulation truly belongs under RL-Augmented, move its body text discussion to §4.3 and update Table 2.

issues.description: Veto (\citep{2601.07155}) taxonomy mismatch. Figure 1 places it under §5.1 White-Box Logit Supervision (Signal axis). Table 2 places it under 'Dynamics' (alongside Stable-OPD, TCOD). The body text discusses it in §5.1 White-Box (line 808) as a teacher adaptation technique. Figure 1 and body text agree; Table 2 is the outlier.
issues.suggested_fix: Change Veto's Category in Table 2 from 'Dynamics' to 'Signal' to match Figure 1 and body text. Or add a secondary category annotation.

issues.description: PAINT taxonomy classification. Table 1 lists PAINT under 'Self (PI)' category. Figure 1 places PAINT under §5.3.2 Self-Play. Body text (line 904) discusses it in the Self-Play subsection, describing it as 'between pure self-play and full PI'. The Figure 1 caption acknowledges this by saying methods are placed under primary contribution. The mismatch is partially justified but may confuse readers cross-referencing Table 1 and Figure 1.
issues.suggested_fix: Consider changing PAINT's Table 1 category from 'Self (PI)' to 'Self (PI+SP)' (matching π-Play's dual classification) to signal its cross-category nature, or add a footnote.

issues.description: Revisiting OPD (\citep{2603.25562}) appears in Table 2 under 'Dynamics' but is absent from Figure 1's taxonomy tree entirely. It is discussed in §6.1 body text (line 949) as an empirical failure mode analysis. Missing from the taxonomy tree despite being in the comparison table.
issues.suggested_fix: Either add Revisiting OPD to Figure 1 under §6.1 Weighting (updating the badge from 4→5), or add a footnote to Table 2 explaining that some methods in the table are analytical/empirical studies not classified in the taxonomy tree.
